docs.title: ChatBug 文档
docs.text:
ChatBug 是 ChatArch 系列的授权网站漏洞验证包。它将 PHP2Shell 风险拆成可审计的证据层级：Web 运行时版本/入口暴露、受控 session/include marker，以及只在无生产数据 lab 中完成的固定 ls/cat 验收。

站点入口：https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatBug/

docs.title: 按场景选择文档
docs.text: 场景 从这里开始 只想确认运行时暴露，不做 gadget 请求 CLI 树：web check 低影响模式 需要理解 marker 探测的影响和证据边界 能力地图 需要本机可运行的回归示例 PHP2Shell 隔离复现实验：本机 contract lab 需要相同 PHP-FPM 运行时中的 ls/cat 验收 PHP2Shell 隔离复现实验：Docker lab 从 Python 调用检查或 lab 生命周期 Python 接口树

docs.title: 推荐路径
docs.text:
• 先做低影响检查

    对自有或已授权 URL 先运行 web check --skip-gadget-scan。它只给出版本和 multipart parser 可达性，不宣称命令执行。

    查看检查边界

  • 再理解 marker 结果

    默认 web check 会增加固定 session/include marker 探测。marker 返回是受控 PHP echo 线索，不是系统命令 RCE 结论。

    查看证据层级

  • 用本机 contract lab 回归

    local-list 不启动 PHP、Docker 或 shell；它锁定请求/响应与正负向控制契约。

    运行本机例子

  • 只在隔离 Docker lab 验收命令输出

    docker-list 使用内部网络、合成 marker、固定 proof allowlist 和自动清理。它是唯一提供 ls/cat 输出的路径。

    运行 Docker lab

docs.title: 当前结论
docs.text:
• 版本头或 parser 可达性是修补优先级证据，不是生产 RCE。
  • session/include marker 返回需要结合目标应用、日志和授权范围复核；它不表示任意系统命令已经执行。
  • docker-list 可以在同运行时、故意加入的 lab-only include gadget 中证明固定命令输出，但不能替代对真实应用 gadget 的审计。
  • ChatBug 不发送 OOM/UAF/崩溃 payload，不读取生产用户数据，也不自动进行生产内存漏洞利用。

docs.title: 本地开发预览
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"
python -m pytest -q
mkdocs build --strict
mkdocs serve

英文入口：https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatBug/en/。每个核心页面都有英文镜像；语言切换器可在页面顶部切换。

docs.title: 能力地图
docs.text: ChatBug 当前负责一项窄而可审计的能力：在明确授权范围内评估 PHP 网站的 PHP2Shell 风险。它严格分开运行时暴露、受控 marker 线索、隔离 lab 命令验收和生产内存漏洞利用。

docs.title: 一等能力
docs.text:
• 普通网站运行时检查

    chatbug php2shell web check <URL> 以普通 Web URL 为入口，而不是按 webmail/CMS 等产品类型拆 CLI。它可读取 PHP 版本、验证 multipart parser，并可选做固定 session/include marker 探测。

  • 本机 contract lab

    chatbug php2shell lab local-list 用进程内 HTTP 服务器锁定正/负向协议契约；它不启动 PHP、Docker 或 shell。

  • 完整运行时 Docker lab

    chatbug php2shell lab docker-list 在自有 Docker 主机上创建 internal-only、一次性、无生产数据的 PHP-FPM/Nginx 环境。只有这里能运行固定 ls/cat proof。

  • 可导入 Python API

    CLI 只做参数和 JSON 输出；版本分类、HTTP 请求、marker 结构、lab 文件和清理生命周期均可独立导入和测试。

docs.title: 能力状态
docs.text: 能力 状态 证据边界 PHP 版本头解析与修复版本分类 已实现并验证 证明版本/配置暴露，不证明可利用 普通 multipart parser 检查 已实现并验证 证明请求可达上传解析路径，不证明文件包含或命令执行 固定 session/include marker 探测 已实现并验证 marker 返回说明候选路径需要进一步复核；不证明任意系统命令或用户文件泄露 本机 LFI/session contract lab 已实现并验证 合成教学/回归链；不运行真实 PHP、shell 或内存破坏 payload 远端 PHP-FPM Docker lab 已实现并验证 只证明指定 runtime + 故意加入 lab-only include gadget 时的固定 ls/cat 输出 CVE-2026-109618/109619 内存破坏 RCE 不提供 不发送 OOM/UAF payload；需要单独风险授权和专门研究 生产服务内存漏洞利用 不默认提供 含真实数据的生产服务只运行低影响检查；不自动利用 任意命令框架 / reverse shell 不提供 docker-list 只接受三个固定 proof 值

docs.title: 真实服务如何映射到产品
docs.text:
真实 PHP webmail 风险评估仍是两个独立问题：

  1. 将服务作为普通 PHP 网站运行 web check，确认实际 HTTP SAPI 的版本和入口；业务类型不应导致一个 Mail 专用 CLI；
  2. 若需要 ls/cat 级验收，在 --fpm-image 指定的同运行时、无数据 Docker lab 中运行 docker-list；lab 仅挂载合成 webroot 和随机 marker，不连接真实邮箱、数据库、附件或用户目录。

因此“这是 Mail 服务”只影响 lab 镜像选择和风险等级，不改变通用 CLI 模型。

docs.title: 安全设计约束
docs.text:
• 所有远程检查都必须针对自有或已授权服务。
  • 生产检查不发送 OOM、UAF、崩溃 payload、暴力重复请求或任意系统命令。
  • 无 --skip-gadget-scan 的 web check 可能在存在 LFI 的目标中触发受控 PHP echo marker；先确认授权范围和日志/维护窗口。
  • Marker 不进入验证 URL、query 或 traversal 字符串，避免输入反射误判。
  • Docker lab 使用内部网络、唯一 Compose project、合成数据和自动清理；--keep 只供短时人工复查。
  • 报告必须明确区分“runtime only”“controlled marker path”和“runtime + lab gadget”。

docs.title: 不在当前范围
docs.text:
• 扫描互联网或未授权主机。
  • 读取真实用户邮件、会话、附件、密钥或生产临时文件。
  • 重启、修补、下架或重新配置生产服务。
  • 隐藏版本 banner 后宣称已修复；修复必须由实际 runtime 版本和发布工件验证。
  • 将 scanner 结论、docker exec 管理面操作、普通 PHP 页面执行或 marker 回显误报为未授权 RCE。

docs.title: CLI 树
docs.text: 以下命令树来自 ChatBug 0.1.0 的真实 Click 注册面。安装后请优先运行 chatbug --tree 回读当前版本；文档只描述已实现命令。

docs.title: 真实命令树
docs.text:
chatbug
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
└── php2shell  # PHP2Shell web checks and data-free lab proof.
    ├── lab  # Disposable, data-free lab workflows.
    │   ├── docker-list [--ssh-host SSH-HOST] [--fpm-image FPM-IMAGE] [--proof PROOF] [--keep]  # Prove list/cat inside a data-free PHP-FPM lab with an intentional include sink.
    │   └── local-list  # Run a complete positive/negative example in an in-process local lab.
    └── web  # Checks for an ordinary owned website URL.
        └── check <URL> [--skip-multipart] [--skip-gadget-scan]  # Check version exposure, parser reachability, and common include gadgets.

docs.title: chatbug php2shell web check <URL>
docs.text:
仅对自己拥有或已获明确授权的网站运行。它会输出 JSON，不发送 OOM/UAF/崩溃 payload，也不调用目标上的系统命令。

运行方式 实际请求 结论边界 web check <URL> --skip-multipart 仅 HEAD/版本头 只有 HTTP/版本可见性 web check <URL> --skip-gadget-scan HEAD + 普通 multipart parser 可达性，不做 session include 请求 web check <URL> 上述请求 + 固定 session/include marker 探测 受控 PHP echo marker 线索，不是 system()/RCE 证明

默认 marker 探测的细节：请求 filename 中只包含固定 <?php echo '<随机 marker>'; ?>，随后用少量固定 page、file、include、path 参数形态检查候选 session 路径。它不会请求真实用户文件，不含 system()，但若应用确有 LFI gadget，可能在目标 PHP 进程内执行该受控 echo 并写入普通请求/session 日志。

因此，无跳过选项的检查应在授权和合适维护窗口内使用；低影响盘点优先选 --skip-gadget-scan。

退出码：

  • 0：版本头显示处于受影响范围；
  • 3：检查已完成，但版本未证明受影响或版本头不可见；
  • 其他非零：本地参数或请求处理错误。

重要字段：

  • verdict=vulnerable_version_exposed：版本暴露，非生产 RCE；
  • evidence_tier=tier_2_parser_reachable：普通 multipart 请求可达；
  • evidence_tier=tier_3_gadget_found：固定 marker 经候选 include 路径返回；
  • rce_or_file_read_proven=true：兼容字段名；当前只表示受控 marker 路径成立，不能解读为任意命令、用户数据读取或内存漏洞利用成功。

docs.title: chatbug php2shell lab local-list
docs.text:
本机 contract lab 用于 CI、文档和回归：

  • 在当前进程临时绑定 127.0.0.1；
  • 模拟 upload-progress/session 和 lab-only include sink 的正向响应；
  • 以普通 hello.php 作为负向控制；
  • 输出合成的 /tmp、chatbug-marker.txt 与随机 marker；
  • 退出时关闭 socket、线程并清空内存状态。

它不启动 PHP、Docker 或系统 shell，因此不能作为真实 PHP 命令执行的证据。真实 PHP-FPM 命令验收应使用下一节的 Docker lab。

docs.title: chatbug php2shell lab docker-list
docs.text:
该命令必须提供 --ssh-host，且只用于自有 Docker 主机。它创建唯一 Compose project、internal Docker network 和临时合成 webroot；不发布主机端口、不挂载生产数据库/邮件/附件/用户目录/凭据/日志。

chatbug php2shell lab docker-list \
  --ssh-host <owned-docker-host> \
  --fpm-image <exact-runtime-image-or-digest> \
  --proof list-and-marker
  • 默认镜像是 php:8.1.34-fpm-alpine，方便验证工作流；
  • 要验证与被评估服务一致的 PHP-FPM runtime，请传入其精确镜像 digest；
  • --keep 会保留临时 lab 供 SSH 人工检查；默认自动清理容器、网络和远端临时目录。

--proof 是固定 allowlist，不接受任意命令：

proof lab 内固定动作 正向验收 list-tmp ls -la /tmp 输出含合成 chatbug-marker.txt 的临时目录列表 cat-marker cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt 输出本次随机 marker list-and-marker ls -la /tmp; echo MARKER; cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt 同时输出目录列表、MARKER 和随机 marker

docker-list 返回 accepted=true 的前提是正/负向 HTTP 状态均为 200、选择 proof 的正向证据出现、负向 hello.php 不出现 marker，并且默认清理完成。它证明的是“指定 PHP-FPM 运行时 + 故意加入的 lab include gadget”可到达固定命令输出，不代表真实业务应用或 PHP2Shell 内存漏洞已被利用。

docs.title: 选择命令
docs.text: 需求 推荐命令 只确认版本暴露 web check <URL> --skip-multipart 确认普通 multipart 入口 web check <URL> --skip-gadget-scan 在授权范围内检查固定 marker/include 线索 web check <URL> 运行无 Docker 的稳定回归用例 lab local-list 验收 PHP-FPM lab 中的固定 ls/cat lab docker-list --ssh-host ... --proof list-and-marker

docs.title: Python 接口树
docs.text: ChatBug CLI 是薄入口；HTTP 证据分层、marker 结构与 lab 生命周期都位于可导入、可测试的 Python 模块中。

docs.title: 包入口
docs.text: from chatbug import __version__

docs.title: 模块树
docs.text:
chatbug
├── cli.py              # Click 参数、JSON 输出与退出码
├── php2shell.py        # Web 版本/marker 检查、固定 lab payload
├── local_lab.py        # 进程内合成 HTTP contract lab
└── lab.py              # 远端一次性 Docker Compose lab 生命周期

docs.title: chatbug.php2shell
docs.text:
from chatbug.php2shell import (
    build_lab_session_payload,
    build_safe_multipart_probe,
    classify_version,
    extract_command_output,
    http_request,
    parse_php_version,
    random_marker,
    safe_url_check,
    scan_common_lfi,
)
接口 用途 安全/证据边界 http_request(...) 无第三方依赖 HTTP 原语 不跟随跳转，最大读取 64 KiB parse_php_version(headers) 解析 Server / X-Powered-By PHP 版本 只读取响应头 classify_version(version) 分类 vulnerable/fixed/unknown 不从隐藏版本推断已修补 random_marker() 生成随机、非敏感 marker marker 不进入验证 URL/query/traversal build_safe_multipart_probe(marker) 构造 upload-progress multipart 请求 无 OOM/UAF/系统命令；filename 含固定 PHP echo marker，只有经 LFI include 才会执行 scan_common_lfi(url, sid, marker) 少量固定 session/include 形态 无任意路径输入；marker 返回只是候选 gadget 线索 safe_url_check(url, ...) 聚合版本、parser 与 marker 证据 不把版本或 marker 路径称为系统命令 RCE build_lab_session_payload(sid, proof) 为隔离 lab 构造固定 proof payload proof 只允许三个 allowlist 模式 extract_command_output(body) 提取 lab 定界后的命令输出 只解析合成 lab 定界符

典型低影响网站检查：

from chatbug.php2shell import safe_url_check

result = safe_url_check(
    "https://owned-site.example/",
    include_multipart=True,
    include_gadgets=False,
)
assert result["schema"] == "chatbug.php2shell.web_check/v1"
assert result["evidence_tier"] == "tier_2_parser_reachable"

启用 include_gadgets=True 前应确认目标授权和维护窗口。rce_or_file_read_proven 是兼容字段；在当前实现中，True 只表示受控 marker 经候选 session/include 路径返回，不表示任意系统命令或真实用户文件读取。

docs.title: chatbug.local_lab
docs.text:
from chatbug.local_lab import serve_local_lab

serve_local_lab() 是 context manager，临时启动 127.0.0.1:0 HTTP 服务：

  • hello.php 固定返回 Hello World；
  • vuln.php 是仅存在于进程内的 include-sink 模拟；
  • context 退出时关闭 socket、线程并清空内存 session。

它不启动 PHP、Docker 或系统 shell，适合单元测试和文档中的最小 contract 用例。

docs.title: chatbug.lab
docs.text:
from chatbug.lab import LabSpec, logs, run_lfi_proof, seed_marker, start, stop
接口 用途 LabSpec(ssh_host=..., fpm_image=...) 描述自有 Docker 主机与精确 PHP-FPM runtime start(spec) 写入合成 Compose/webroot 并启动 internal lab seed_marker(spec, remote_dir, marker) 在 lab /tmp 写入随机合成 marker run_lfi_proof(spec, remote_dir, sid, proof) 由内部一次性 client 执行固定正/负向验收 logs(spec, remote_dir) 读取有界 lab 日志用于失败诊断 stop(spec, remote_dir) 删除 Compose project、network 和远端临时目录

这些接口只生成合成文件，不接受生产路径、生产卷或任意远程命令。CLI 的 docker-list 在 finally 中调用清理；只有显式 --keep 才短时保留。

docs.title: 网站检查
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.web_check/v1

关键字段：verdict、evidence_tier、rce_or_file_read_proven、findings、multipart、gadget_scan。其中 rce_or_file_read_proven 需按上文兼容语义解释。

docs.title: 本机 contract lab
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.local_lab/v1

关键字段：accepted、post_status、positive_status、negative_status、positive_output、negative_body。

docs.title: Docker runtime lab
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.docker_lab/v1

关键字段：accepted、fpm_image、proof、marker、seed、result.positive_output、result.negative_output、cleanup。

docs.title: PHP2Shell 隔离复现实验
docs.text:
本文给出 ChatBug 的完整可运行验收路径，并明确它验证什么、没有验证什么。它使用普通网站模型，不为某一个具体业务系统保留专用 CLI。

关键边界：PHP2Shell CVE 是 PHP 运行时内存安全问题。ChatBug 不向生产或 lab 发送 CVE-2026-109618/109619 的 OOM、UAF 或崩溃 payload。本页的完整 lab 验证的是另一条确定性的传统链：session upload-progress + 应用 include gadget。两者都可能影响修补优先级，但不能相互替代或混称为同一个生产 RCE 结论。

docs.title: 先选择正确的证据层级
docs.text: 目标 推荐命令 可以得出的结论 不能得出的结论 只盘点运行时版本 web check <URL> --skip-multipart HTTP/版本头暴露 parser、gadget 或命令执行 确认普通上传入口 web check <URL> --skip-gadget-scan multipart parser 可达 LFI、PHP echo、系统命令 检查固定 session/include marker web check <URL> 受控 marker 路径线索 任意命令、用户数据读取、内存漏洞利用 回归请求/响应契约 lab local-list 本机正/负向协议契约 真实 PHP 或 shell 执行 验收固定命令输出 lab docker-list runtime + lab-only gadget 可执行固定 ls/cat 真实应用 gadget 或生产 CVE 利用

docs.title: lab-only 链概览
docs.text:
下面的链只在 docker-list 创建的临时环境中生成：

multipart POST
  └─ PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS 写入 lab session 文件
      └─ filename 只携带固定 allowlist proof 的 PHP 代码
          └─ lab-only include($_GET['page']) 包含 session 文件
              └─ 固定 ls/cat 输出经正向响应返回

真实应用缺少其中任一条件时，都不能得到相同结论：

  • 没有应用 include/LFI sink，只能报告 runtime/parser 暴露；
  • docker exec ... php 是管理面执行，不是未认证利用；
  • 普通 PHP 页面可以读取文件，也不代表远程攻击者能执行命令。

docs.title: 本机 contract lab
docs.text:
python -m pip install ChatBug
chatbug php2shell lab local-list

该命令在当前进程中启动绑定 127.0.0.1:0 的临时 HTTP 服务，并执行正/负向控制：

  • multipart 请求被记录为合成 session 状态；
  • 正向 vuln.php 返回合成 /tmp、chatbug-marker.txt 和随机 marker；
  • 负向 hello.php 只返回 Hello World；
  • context 退出时关闭 socket、线程并清空内存状态。

成功 JSON 的关键形状：

{
  "accepted": true,
  "positive_status": 200,
  "negative_status": 200,
  "positive_output": "/tmp\nchatbug-marker.txt\nCHATBUG_MARKER_EXAMPLE",
  "negative_body": "Hello World\n"
}

这是确定性的 contract/regression 用例，不启动真实 PHP、Docker 或系统 shell。适合 CI：

python -m pytest -q tests/test_php2shell.py

docs.title: Docker 运行时 lab
docs.text:
在自有 Docker 主机上运行：

chatbug php2shell lab docker-list \
  --ssh-host <owned-docker-host> \
  --fpm-image <exact-runtime-image-or-digest> \
  --proof list-and-marker

--ssh-host 是必填项。默认镜像 php:8.1.34-fpm-alpine 用于工作流验证；若要与被评估服务比对，必须将 --fpm-image 指向同一 PHP-FPM 运行时的精确 digest。

每次运行会在远端 <chatarch-home>/chatbug/labs/ 下创建唯一目录，并只生成：

  • 指定 PHP-FPM 镜像、Nginx 和一次性 Python client；
  • hello.php，固定输出 Hello World；
  • vuln.php，只存在于 lab，含 include($_GET['page'])；
  • upload-progress/session 配置；
  • internal-only Docker network；
  • /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt 中的随机合成 marker。

它不会挂载生产数据库、邮件、附件、用户目录、凭据、日志或真实 session 目录，也不会发布主机端口。默认会删除 Compose 项目、网络和远端临时目录；--keep 仅用于短时 SSH 人工排查。

docs.title: 固定 proof 模式
docs.text:
--proof 没有任意 shell 参数，只允许：

proof 固定 lab 内动作 正向验收 list-tmp ls -la /tmp 列表包含合成 chatbug-marker.txt cat-marker cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt 输出本次随机 marker list-and-marker ls -la /tmp; echo MARKER; cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt 同时输出列表、MARKER 与随机 marker

默认的 list-and-marker 是最完整、最容易审计的验收模式。

docs.title: 正向与负向验收
docs.text:
list-and-marker 成功时，result.positive_output 的形式如下；ChatBug 会去掉内部定界符，只保留命令输出：

total 24
...
-rw-r--r-- ... chatbug-marker.txt
-rw------- ... sess_lab...
MARKER
CHATBUG_MARKER_...

result.negative_output 必须为：

Hello World

accepted=true 的条件因 proof 而异，但始终要求：

  • multipart POST、正向 include 和负向普通页面均返回 200；
  • 正向输出出现对应的固定证据（list-tmp 是 marker 文件名；另两种 proof 是随机 marker）；
  • 负向输出不含随机 marker；
  • 未指定 --keep 时，Compose 项目和远端临时目录完成清理。

这个结果应表述为“指定 runtime + lab-only include gadget 已在隔离环境中证明”，而不是“生产 PHP2Shell RCE 已复现”。

docs.title: 低影响版本/入口检查
docs.text:
chatbug php2shell web check https://owned-service.example/ --skip-gadget-scan

这会执行版本头读取和普通 multipart parser 检查。它不发送 session include 请求，适合作为生产初始盘点。

docs.title: 授权范围内的 marker 探测
docs.text:
chatbug php2shell web check https://owned-service.example/

这个模式额外发送固定 <?php echo '<marker>'; ?> filename，并探测固定少量 session/include 形态。它不会执行系统命令或读取真实用户文件，但 LFI 存在时可导致该受控 echo 在目标 PHP 进程中执行。只在明确授权、日志/维护窗口合适的情况下使用。

字段 正确解释 verdict=vulnerable_version_exposed 版本头在受影响范围；需要确认真实 HTTP SAPI 并安排修补 evidence_tier=tier_2_parser_reachable 普通 multipart 请求已到达 parser 路径 evidence_tier=tier_3_gadget_found 固定 marker 经候选 session/include 路径返回，需要人工复核应用 gadget rce_or_file_read_proven=true 兼容字段；表示受控 marker 路径，而非任意系统命令、真实文件读取或 CVE 内存利用成功

docs.title: 复现后的处置
docs.text:
1. 盘点真正服务 HTTP 请求的 PHP SAPI：FPM、mod_php、FrankenPHP、LiteSpeed 等；CLI 版本不是 Web 运行时结论。
  2. 升级到官方修复版本，并以运行中容器 digest、包版本或 HTTP SAPI 版本回读验证。
  3. 审计并移除不受信任的文件包含/路径拼接 sink。
  4. 收紧上传、session 保存路径、临时目录权限和错误暴露。
  5. 修补后先重跑低影响 web check --skip-gadget-scan，再在同镜像 data-free lab 重跑正/负向验收。
  6. 如怀疑已被利用，单独进行访问日志、异常 session、WebShell、子进程和出站连接取证；漏洞验证不能替代取证。

docs.title: ChatBug Docs
docs.text:
ChatBug is a ChatArch package for authorized website vulnerability validation. It separates PHP2Shell risk into auditable evidence tiers: Web-runtime version/entry-point exposure, a controlled session/include marker, and fixed ls/cat acceptance performed only in a lab with no production data.

Site entry: https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatBug/en/

docs.title: Choose a Path
docs.text: Goal Start here Confirm runtime exposure without gadget requests CLI Tree: low-impact web check Understand marker-probe effects and evidence boundaries Capability Map Run a local, runnable regression example PHP2Shell Lab: local contract lab Obtain ls/cat acceptance in a matching PHP-FPM runtime PHP2Shell Lab: Docker runtime lab Call checks or lab lifecycle APIs from Python Python Interface Tree

docs.title: Recommended Route
docs.text:
• Start with a low-impact check

    Run web check --skip-gadget-scan against an owned or authorized URL. It reports version and multipart-parser reachability without asserting command execution.

    Read the check boundary

  • Interpret marker results precisely

    Default web check adds a fixed session/include marker probe. Marker return is a controlled PHP echo lead, not a system-command RCE conclusion.

    Read the evidence tiers

  • Use the local contract lab for regression

    local-list starts no PHP, Docker, or shell. It locks the request/response and positive/negative-control contract.

    Run the local example

  • Accept command output only in the isolated Docker lab

    docker-list uses an internal network, synthetic marker, fixed proof allowlist, and automatic cleanup. It is the only path that returns ls/cat output.

    Run the Docker lab

docs.title: Current Conclusions
docs.text:
• Version headers and parser reachability are patch-priority evidence, not production RCE.
  • A session/include marker return needs authorization-aware review of the application and logs; it does not show arbitrary system-command execution.
  • docker-list can prove fixed command output in a matching runtime with an intentionally added lab-only include gadget. It does not replace an audit for a real application gadget.
  • ChatBug sends no OOM/UAF/crash payload, reads no production user data, and does not automate production memory-vulnerability exploitation.

docs.title: Local Development Preview
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"
python -m pytest -q
mkdocs build --strict
mkdocs serve

The Chinese entry is https://arch.gh.wzhecnu.cn/ChatBug/. Every core page has an English mirror; use the language selector at the top of a page to switch languages.

docs.title: Capability Map
docs.text: ChatBug owns one narrow, auditable capability: assessing PHP2Shell risk for PHP websites under explicit authorization. It keeps runtime exposure, controlled marker leads, isolated lab command acceptance, and production memory-vulnerability exploitation separate.

docs.title: First-Class Capabilities
docs.text:
• Ordinary website runtime checks

    chatbug php2shell web check <URL> starts from an ordinary Web URL rather than a product-specific webmail/CMS CLI group. It reads PHP version exposure, verifies multipart parsing, and can optionally run a fixed session/include marker probe.

  • Local contract lab

    chatbug php2shell lab local-list uses an in-process HTTP server to lock the positive/negative protocol contract. It starts no PHP, Docker, or shell.

  • Full-runtime Docker lab

    chatbug php2shell lab docker-list creates an internal-only, disposable PHP-FPM/Nginx environment with no production data on an owned Docker host. It is the only location where fixed ls/cat proof actions run.

  • Importable Python API

    The CLI only handles arguments and JSON output. Version classification, HTTP requests, marker structure, lab files, and cleanup lifecycle are independently importable and testable.

docs.title: Capability Status
docs.text: Capability Status Evidence boundary PHP version-header parsing and fixed-release classification Implemented and verified Proves version/config exposure, not exploitability Ordinary multipart parser check Implemented and verified Proves a request reaches the upload-parser path, not file inclusion or command execution Fixed session/include marker probe Implemented and verified Marker return is a candidate-path lead requiring review; it does not prove arbitrary system command or user-file disclosure Local LFI/session contract lab Implemented and verified Synthetic teaching/regression chain; no real PHP, shell, or memory-corruption payload Remote PHP-FPM Docker lab Implemented and verified Proves fixed ls/cat output only with a selected runtime plus intentionally added lab-only include gadget CVE-2026-109618/109619 memory-corruption RCE Not provided No OOM/UAF payload; requires separate risk authorization and dedicated research Production memory-vulnerability exploitation Not provided by default Live services with real data receive low-impact checks only; no automatic exploitation Arbitrary-command framework / reverse shell Not provided docker-list accepts exactly three fixed proof values

docs.title: How a Real Service Maps to the Product
docs.text:
A real PHP webmail risk assessment is still two independent questions:

  1. Treat it as an ordinary PHP website for web check, identifying the version and entry point exposed by the actual HTTP SAPI; service type does not warrant a Mail-specific CLI.
  2. When ls/cat-level acceptance is needed, run docker-list with --fpm-image set to a matching runtime in a data-free Docker lab. The lab mounts only a synthetic webroot and random marker, never real mailboxes, databases, attachments, or user directories.

“Mail service” affects the lab image selection and risk level; it does not change the generic CLI model.

docs.title: Safety Constraints
docs.text:
• Every remote check must target an owned or explicitly authorized service.
  • Production checks send no OOM, UAF, crash payload, brute-force repetition, or arbitrary system command.
  • web check without --skip-gadget-scan can trigger a controlled PHP echo marker where an LFI exists; confirm authorization and an appropriate logging/maintenance window first.
  • The marker never appears in the validation URL, query, or traversal string, preventing input-reflection false positives.
  • Docker labs use an internal network, unique Compose project, synthetic data, and automatic cleanup; --keep is for short manual inspection only.
  • Reports must distinguish “runtime only,” “controlled marker path,” and “runtime + lab gadget.”

docs.title: Out of Scope
docs.text:
• Internet-wide or unauthorized scanning.
  • Reading real user mail, sessions, attachments, secrets, or production temporary files.
  • Restarting, patching, taking offline, or reconfiguring production.
  • Hiding a version banner and calling a service patched; remediation must be proven by the actual runtime version and released artifacts.
  • Misreporting scanner output, docker exec management-plane operation, ordinary PHP page execution, or marker reflection as unauthenticated RCE.

docs.title: CLI Tree
docs.text: The tree below comes from ChatBug 0.1.0's registered Click surface. After installation, use chatbug --tree to read back the installed contract; this page describes implemented commands only.

docs.title: Registered Command Tree
docs.text:
chatbug
├── --help  # Show this message and exit.
├── --version  # Show the version and exit.
├── --tree  # Print the registered CLI tree and exit.
├── --tree-brief  # Print the registered CLI tree without parameter signatures and exit.
└── php2shell  # PHP2Shell web checks and data-free lab proof.
    ├── lab  # Disposable, data-free lab workflows.
    │   ├── docker-list [--ssh-host SSH-HOST] [--fpm-image FPM-IMAGE] [--proof PROOF] [--keep]  # Prove list/cat inside a data-free PHP-FPM lab with an intentional include sink.
    │   └── local-list  # Run a complete positive/negative example in an in-process local lab.
    └── web  # Checks for an ordinary owned website URL.
        └── check <URL> [--skip-multipart] [--skip-gadget-scan]  # Check version exposure, parser reachability, and common include gadgets.

docs.title: chatbug php2shell web check <URL>
docs.text:
Run this only against a website you own or are explicitly authorized to test. It emits JSON, sends no OOM/UAF/crash payload, and does not invoke a system command on the target.

Invocation Actual requests Evidence boundary web check <URL> --skip-multipart HEAD/version headers only HTTP/version visibility only web check <URL> --skip-gadget-scan HEAD plus ordinary multipart Parser reachability; no session-include request web check <URL> Above requests plus a fixed session/include marker probe Controlled PHP echo marker lead, not a system()/RCE proof

The default marker probe sends only a fixed <?php echo '<random marker>'; ?> filename, then checks a small fixed set of page, file, include, and path shapes against candidate session locations. It requests no real user file and contains no system() call. If the application has an LFI gadget, it can still execute that controlled echo in the target PHP process and create ordinary request/session logs.

Use the no-skip form only within authorized scope and an appropriate maintenance window. For low-impact inventory, prefer --skip-gadget-scan.

Exit codes:

  • 0: the version banner indicates an affected range;
  • 3: the check completed, but an affected version was not proven or the version header is hidden;
  • other non-zero values: local argument or request-processing error.

Important fields:

  • verdict=vulnerable_version_exposed: version exposure, not production RCE;
  • evidence_tier=tier_2_parser_reachable: ordinary multipart traffic reached the parser path;
  • evidence_tier=tier_3_gadget_found: the fixed marker returned through a candidate include path;
  • rce_or_file_read_proven=true: a compatibility field name; it currently means only that the controlled marker path worked, not arbitrary command execution, user-data reading, or memory-vulnerability exploitation.

docs.title: chatbug php2shell lab local-list
docs.text:
The local contract lab is for CI, documentation, and regression:

  • binds a temporary 127.0.0.1 HTTP endpoint in the current process;
  • simulates the upload-progress/session and lab-only include-sink positive response;
  • uses ordinary hello.php as the negative control;
  • emits synthetic /tmp, chatbug-marker.txt, and random-marker output;
  • closes the socket/thread and clears in-memory state on exit.

It starts no PHP, Docker, or system shell, so it is not evidence of real PHP command execution. Use the Docker lab for actual PHP-FPM acceptance.

docs.title: chatbug php2shell lab docker-list
docs.text:
This command requires --ssh-host and is only for an owned Docker host. It creates a unique Compose project, internal Docker network, and temporary synthetic webroot. It publishes no host port and mounts no production database, mail, attachment, user-directory, credential, or log volume.

chatbug php2shell lab docker-list \
  --ssh-host <owned-docker-host> \
  --fpm-image <exact-runtime-image-or-digest> \
  --proof list-and-marker
  • The default image is php:8.1.34-fpm-alpine for workflow validation.
  • For parity with an assessed service, pass its exact PHP-FPM image digest.
  • --keep retains the temporary lab for SSH inspection; otherwise containers, network, and remote temporary directory are removed.

--proof is a fixed allowlist and never accepts arbitrary commands:

proof Fixed lab action Positive acceptance list-tmp ls -la /tmp Lists the synthetic chatbug-marker.txt in the temporary directory cat-marker cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt Returns this run's random marker list-and-marker ls -la /tmp; echo MARKER; cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt Returns listing, MARKER, and random marker

docker-list returns accepted=true only when positive/negative HTTP statuses are 200, the proof-specific positive evidence appears, the negative hello.php response contains no marker, and default cleanup completes. It proves that the selected PHP-FPM runtime plus an intentionally added lab include gadget reaches fixed command output; it does not show that a real application or a PHP2Shell memory vulnerability was exploited.

docs.title: Choose a Command
docs.text: Goal Recommended command Confirm version exposure only web check <URL> --skip-multipart Confirm ordinary multipart entry point web check <URL> --skip-gadget-scan Check a fixed marker/include lead within authorized scope web check <URL> Run a stable Docker-free regression lab local-list Accept fixed PHP-FPM-lab ls/cat output lab docker-list --ssh-host ... --proof list-and-marker

docs.title: Python Interface Tree
docs.text: The ChatBug CLI is thin. HTTP evidence classification, marker construction, and lab lifecycle are importable, testable Python modules.

docs.title: Package Entry
docs.text: from chatbug import __version__

docs.title: Module Tree
docs.text:
chatbug
├── cli.py              # Click arguments, JSON output, and exit codes
├── php2shell.py        # Web version/marker checks and fixed lab payload
├── local_lab.py        # In-process synthetic HTTP contract lab
└── lab.py              # Remote disposable Docker Compose lab lifecycle

docs.title: chatbug.php2shell
docs.text:
from chatbug.php2shell import (
    build_lab_session_payload,
    build_safe_multipart_probe,
    classify_version,
    extract_command_output,
    http_request,
    parse_php_version,
    random_marker,
    safe_url_check,
    scan_common_lfi,
)
API Purpose Safety/evidence boundary http_request(...) Dependency-free HTTP primitive Does not follow redirects; reads at most 64 KiB parse_php_version(headers) Parse PHP version from Server / X-Powered-By Response headers only classify_version(version) Classify vulnerable/fixed/unknown Does not infer patch status from a hidden version random_marker() Generate random non-sensitive marker Marker never appears in validation URL/query/traversal build_safe_multipart_probe(marker) Build upload-progress multipart request No OOM/UAF/system command; filename contains a fixed PHP echo marker that runs only through an LFI include scan_common_lfi(url, sid, marker) Probe a small fixed set of session/include shapes No arbitrary path input; marker return is a candidate-gadget lead safe_url_check(url, ...) Aggregate version/parser/marker evidence Never describes a version or marker path as system-command RCE build_lab_session_payload(sid, proof) Build fixed proof payload for isolated lab proof permits exactly three allowlisted modes extract_command_output(body) Extract delimited lab command output Parses synthetic lab delimiters only

Typical low-impact website check:

from chatbug.php2shell import safe_url_check

result = safe_url_check(
    "https://owned-site.example/",
    include_multipart=True,
    include_gadgets=False,
)
assert result["schema"] == "chatbug.php2shell.web_check/v1"
assert result["evidence_tier"] == "tier_2_parser_reachable"

Before enabling include_gadgets=True, confirm target authorization and a suitable maintenance window. rce_or_file_read_proven is a compatibility field; in the current implementation, True only means that a controlled marker returned through a candidate session/include path, not arbitrary system-command execution or real user-file disclosure.

docs.title: chatbug.local_lab
docs.text:
from chatbug.local_lab import serve_local_lab

serve_local_lab() is a context manager that starts a temporary HTTP service on 127.0.0.1:0:

  • hello.php always returns Hello World;
  • vuln.php is an in-process include-sink simulation only;
  • context exit closes the socket/thread and clears in-memory session state.

It starts no PHP, Docker, or system shell, making it suitable for unit tests and minimal contract examples.

docs.title: chatbug.lab
docs.text:
from chatbug.lab import LabSpec, logs, run_lfi_proof, seed_marker, start, stop
API Purpose LabSpec(ssh_host=..., fpm_image=...) Describe an owned Docker host and exact PHP-FPM runtime start(spec) Write synthetic Compose/webroot and start internal lab seed_marker(spec, remote_dir, marker) Write random synthetic marker under lab /tmp run_lfi_proof(spec, remote_dir, sid, proof) Run fixed positive/negative proof from one-shot internal client logs(spec, remote_dir) Return bounded lab logs for diagnostics stop(spec, remote_dir) Remove Compose project, network, and remote temporary directory

These APIs generate only synthetic files and accept no production path, production volume, or arbitrary remote command. The CLI calls cleanup from finally; only explicit --keep retains the lab briefly.

docs.title: Website check
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.web_check/v1

Key fields: verdict, evidence_tier, rce_or_file_read_proven, findings, multipart, and gadget_scan. Interpret rce_or_file_read_proven using the compatibility semantics above.

docs.title: Local contract lab
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.local_lab/v1

Key fields: accepted, post_status, positive_status, negative_status, positive_output, and negative_body.

docs.title: Docker runtime lab
docs.text:
chatbug.php2shell.docker_lab/v1

Key fields: accepted, fpm_image, proof, marker, seed, result.positive_output, result.negative_output, and cleanup.

docs.title: PHP2Shell Isolated Reproduction Lab
docs.text:
This page gives ChatBug's complete runnable acceptance path and states exactly what it proves and what it does not. It uses the ordinary-website model rather than reserving a product-specific CLI for any one application.

Critical boundary: the PHP2Shell CVEs are PHP runtime memory-safety issues. ChatBug does not send OOM, UAF, or crash payloads for CVE-2026-109618/109619 to either production or the lab. The full lab on this page validates a different deterministic chain: session upload-progress + application include gadget. Both may affect patch priority, but they cannot be substituted for or described as the same production-RCE conclusion.

docs.title: Choose the Right Evidence Tier
docs.text: Goal Recommended command What it can establish What it cannot establish Inventory only the runtime version web check <URL> --skip-multipart HTTP/version-banner exposure Parser, gadget, or command execution Confirm ordinary upload entry point web check <URL> --skip-gadget-scan Multipart parser reachability LFI, PHP echo, or system command Check a fixed session/include marker web check <URL> Controlled marker-path lead Arbitrary command, user-data read, or memory-CVE exploitation Regress request/response contract lab local-list Local positive/negative protocol contract Real PHP or shell execution Accept fixed command output lab docker-list Fixed ls/cat with runtime + lab-only gadget Real application gadget or production-CVE exploitation

docs.title: Lab-Only Chain Overview
docs.text:
The following chain is generated only by the temporary environment created by docker-list:

multipart POST
  └─ PHP_SESSION_UPLOAD_PROGRESS writes a lab session file
      └─ filename carries PHP code for a fixed allowlisted proof
          └─ lab-only include($_GET['page']) includes the session file
              └─ fixed ls/cat output returns in the positive response

A real application must meet every condition for the same conclusion:

  • without an application include/LFI sink, report only runtime/parser exposure;
  • docker exec ... php is management-plane execution, not unauthenticated exploitation;
  • an ordinary PHP page reading a file does not mean a remote attacker can execute a command.

docs.title: Local Contract Lab
docs.text:
python -m pip install ChatBug
chatbug php2shell lab local-list

The command starts a temporary HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1:0 in the current process and runs positive and negative controls:

  • a multipart request is recorded as synthetic session state;
  • positive vuln.php returns synthetic /tmp, chatbug-marker.txt, and a random marker;
  • negative hello.php returns only Hello World;
  • context cleanup closes socket/thread resources and clears in-memory state.

Successful JSON shape:

{
  "accepted": true,
  "positive_status": 200,
  "negative_status": 200,
  "positive_output": "/tmp\nchatbug-marker.txt\nCHATBUG_MARKER_EXAMPLE",
  "negative_body": "Hello World\n"
}

This is a deterministic contract/regression example. It starts no real PHP, Docker, or system shell. Use it in CI:

python -m pytest -q tests/test_php2shell.py

docs.title: Docker Runtime Lab
docs.text:
Run this on an owned Docker host:

chatbug php2shell lab docker-list \
  --ssh-host <owned-docker-host> \
  --fpm-image <exact-runtime-image-or-digest> \
  --proof list-and-marker

--ssh-host is required. The default php:8.1.34-fpm-alpine image validates the workflow; for parity with an assessed service, --fpm-image must name the exact PHP-FPM runtime digest.

Each run creates a unique directory under remote <chatarch-home>/chatbug/labs/ and only generates:

  • the selected PHP-FPM image, Nginx, and one-shot Python client;
  • hello.php, which always returns Hello World;
  • vuln.php, existing only in the lab, containing include($_GET['page']);
  • upload-progress/session settings;
  • an internal-only Docker network;
  • a random synthetic marker at /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt.

It mounts no production database, mail, attachment, user-directory, credential, log, or real session volume, and publishes no host port. By default it deletes the Compose project, network, and remote temporary directory; --keep is only for short SSH investigation.

docs.title: Fixed Proof Modes
docs.text:
--proof has no arbitrary shell parameter. It permits exactly:

proof Fixed lab action Positive acceptance list-tmp ls -la /tmp The listing includes synthetic chatbug-marker.txt cat-marker cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt Returns this run's random marker list-and-marker ls -la /tmp; echo MARKER; cat /tmp/chatbug-marker.txt Returns listing, MARKER, and random marker

The default list-and-marker is the most complete and auditable acceptance mode.

docs.title: Positive and Negative Acceptance
docs.text:
With list-and-marker, result.positive_output looks like the following. ChatBug removes its internal delimiters and retains only command output:

total 24
...
-rw-r--r-- ... chatbug-marker.txt
-rw------- ... sess_lab...
MARKER
CHATBUG_MARKER_...

result.negative_output must be:

Hello World

The exact positive condition varies by proof, but accepted=true always requires:

  • HTTP 200 from multipart POST, positive include, and negative normal page;
  • proof-specific positive evidence (list-tmp uses the marker filename; the other two use the random marker);
  • no random marker in negative output;
  • Compose project and remote directory cleanup unless --keep was selected.

Describe this result as “selected runtime plus lab-only include gadget proven in isolation,” never as “production PHP2Shell RCE reproduced.”

docs.title: Low-Impact Version/Entry-Point Check
docs.text:
chatbug php2shell web check https://owned-service.example/ --skip-gadget-scan

This reads version headers and sends an ordinary multipart parser check. It makes no session-include request and is appropriate for initial production inventory.

docs.title: Authorized Marker Probe
docs.text:
chatbug php2shell web check https://owned-service.example/

This mode additionally sends a fixed <?php echo '<marker>'; ?> filename and probes a small fixed set of session/include shapes. It executes no system command and reads no real user file, but an LFI can cause the controlled echo in the target PHP process. Use it only under explicit authorization and an appropriate logging/maintenance window.

Field Correct interpretation verdict=vulnerable_version_exposed Version banner is affected; confirm the real HTTP SAPI and plan remediation evidence_tier=tier_2_parser_reachable Ordinary multipart traffic reached parser path evidence_tier=tier_3_gadget_found Fixed marker returned through a candidate session/include path; manually review the application gadget rce_or_file_read_proven=true Compatibility field meaning controlled marker path, not arbitrary system command, real file read, or CVE memory-exploit success

docs.title: Remediation After Reproduction
docs.text:
1. Inventory every PHP SAPI serving real HTTP traffic: FPM, mod_php, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed, and so on. CLI versions are not Web-runtime evidence.
  2. Upgrade to the official fixed release, then read back the running container digest, package version, or HTTP-SAPI version.
  3. Audit and remove untrusted file-inclusion/path-construction sinks.
  4. Tighten upload handling, session save paths, temporary-directory permissions, and error exposure.
  5. After remediation, rerun low-impact web check --skip-gadget-scan, then rerun positive/negative acceptance in the same-image data-free lab.
  6. If compromise is suspected, separately investigate access logs, abnormal sessions, webshells, child processes, and outbound connections. Vulnerability validation is not forensics.
